svg.text: claudia — Server settings ▸ Fonts ▸ Manage files of a collection, proposed (E3.13 f2)
A collection added here can be changed after it was made: see its files, add files, remove files. Nothing changes until a button says so.
A · The card's menu: Manage files… first
Same ⋯ menu as Rename… and Remove collection…; only for collections added on this page.
Set up on this page by anna, 2026-11-16.
Collections that are not added here are read-only
Same list, no buttons that change it.
No ⋯ menu: the files are not Claudia's
Keys: the menu opens with Enter or Space on ⋯; its entries have the keys shown while it is open.
Every entry is a button in a menu (role=menu), as Rename… and Remove collection… already are.
The Fonts page keeps its card order; a card does not move when its files change.
B · Manage files: one row per file
What each file is, whether the server uses it, and if not, why in words.
◐ This server · Licensed to the City (contract 2024-117) · added by anna, 2026-11-16
Hausschrift Sans · Bold Italic · TrueType · 205 KB
Forbids embedding (fsType 2), so no PDF could carry it.
Removing a file deletes it from this server's disk. Documents keep asking for
the same font and are drawn and printed with a stand-in until a file of that
family and style is added again. Documents themselves are not changed.
Each Remove button is named for its file: “Remove HausschriftSans-Italic.ttf”.
C · Remove one file: said before it happens
A small dialog over the list, as for Remove collection…; the safe button has the focus.
Hausschrift Sans Italic will no longer be available on this server.
Documents that ask for it keep asking, and are shown and printed with
a stand-in until the file is added again. Their text is not changed.
The file is deleted from the server's disk. This cannot be undone here.
The last file of a collection cannot be removed
A collection keeps at least one file. To take everything away, use
Remove collection… in the card's menu.
The disabled button stays in the tab order (aria-disabled) and says why in its own description,
so a screen reader hears the reason and does not meet a button that is silently dead.
After a removal the page and this list show the new state at once;
LaTeX and the layout use it from the next job.
D · Add files to this collection: check first, then add
The dialog of Add fonts…, without the name and licence questions: those belong to the collection.
Add files to City office fonts
Same licence and scope as the collection: ◐ This server · Licensed to the City (contract 2024-117)
Replaces the file of the same family and style in this collection (198 KB, added 2026-11-16).
Used instead of Inter from Shipped with Claudia, for every document here.
Adds 1 file and replaces 2 on Studio server. Documents here that ask for these fonts are laid out
with them from now on. Nothing else changes: the collection keeps its licence and scope.
“Add 3 files” counts every file that will be written.
Numbers: 1 first entry, key Alt+M · 2 read-only “View files…” for collections not added here · 3 Add files… reuses the check-then-add dialog · 4 each file: what it is,
used or not, and why · 5 removal said in words, safe button focused · 6 the last file stays · 7 replacing is named before it happens.
